This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed 
every six months as indicated by M6 in the title block.

The basic function of the steam turbine in a multi 
shaft (STAG) plant is to generate efficient electric power from heat which would 
other wise be wasted by the multiple gas turbine exhaust flows.

The system accepts available steam from HRSG`S 
which convert the waste heat energy from their associated gas turbine into 
usable steam energy

The first draft initiated by eng. Mahmoud Abo El-Fetouh 
Shata, tested by eng. Ali Abd El-Salam and revised by MDEPC quality control engineer 
Abouda Elbana, accepted by general director eng. Yosry Abd El-Maqsood and approved 
by eng Farouk Awad head sector of Talkha power station.

This document accepted by eng. Samir Abd El-Gilil 
MDEPC inspection & quality control general director MPIS coordinator & certified 
by accountant Mohamed Nageb MDEPC admin & financial prediction head sector & 
supervisor of inspection & quality control head sector.

Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed 
every six months as indicated by M6 in the title block.
The basic function of the steam turbine in a multi 
shaft (STAG) plant is to generate efficient electric power from heat which would 
other wise be wasted by the multiple gas turbine exhaust flows.
The system accepts available steam from HRSG`S 
which convert the waste heat energy from their associated gas turbine into 
usable steam energy
The first draft initiated by eng. Mahmoud Abo El-Fetouh 
Shata, tested by eng. Ali Abd El-Salam and revised by MDEPC quality control engineer 
Abouda Elbana, accepted by general director eng. Yosry Abd El-Maqsood and approved 
by eng Farouk Awad head sector of Talkha power station.
This document accepted by eng. Samir Abd El-Gilil 
MDEPC inspection & quality control general director MPIS coordinator & certified 
by accountant Mohamed Nageb MDEPC admin & financial prediction head sector & 
supervisor of inspection & quality control head sector.
Technical Specification
Turbine type | SCSF STAG 405 (industrial) - 
14STAGES | Rated speed | 3000 r.p.m
Rating | 50.790 KW | Primary trip | 3360 r.p.m
Initial pressure | 575 psig | Emergency trip | 3420 r.p.m
Initial temperature | 866 F | Thrust bearing (Active and 
 inactive) | Tapered
Back pressure | 1.75 inches Hg Abs | Journal bearings | 1.2 (Eliptical)
Safety 
Precautions
A 
 work permit must be issued and qualified maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category.
Safety 
 fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Shutdown the unit
Lock 
 the condensate pumps (1&2) switches, close isolate valves and isolate the 
 power
Lock 
 the vacuum pumps (1&2) switches, close isolate valves and isolate the power
Isolate compressed air for all valve
Switch off gland exhaust and oil vapor extractor
Switch off ventilation system
Generator should be isolated
Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool 
 set
Special tools for turbine
Welding machine
Screw driver set
Jacks (hydraulic, screw)
Filler gauge
Telescope gage
Dial indicator with 
 magnet base
Cleaning liquid & rags
Work to be carried out
Ensure the unit shutdown
Check alignment for 
 coupling between turbine & generator axial (0.01 mm) lopes down & radial 
 (0.02mm) and record it
Inspect bolts, studs, 
 dowel fits, dowel nuts for cracks and loosen
Check and measure the 
 vibration for bearing no. 1&2&3&4
Review the valves 
 position
